name: DingDuff
description:
DingDuff gives Claude the ability to directly access the law without going through another AI system. Once connected to DingDuff, Claude can:

• Browse, search, view, and download state and federal statutes, regulations, and court rules such as rules of civil procedure, rules of evidence, etc. 
• Search, view, and download federal and state court opinions using boolean operators, fielded searches, phrase matching, and citation-network lookup ("show every case citing X").
• Pull PACER dockets and documents through the CourtListener RECAP archive. 
• Run a deterministic citation review on a drafted memo or brief with the source passage highlighted alongside the cite for easy human verification. Quotes are checked against the cited authority programmatically (not by AI), preventing hallucinated citations from getting through. 

DingDuff was built by  attorneys who use it daily, making it a tool that does what attorneys actually need and a tool that attorneys actually like to use.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DingDuff to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DingDuff to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.dingduff.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DingDuff MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DingDuff lists 25 MCP tools, including check_pacer_availability, citecheck_review, codes_browse, codes_search, codes_view, courtlistener_full_search, document_search_across_pacer_dockets, metadata_view, opinion_extract, opinion_search, fetch_opinion_file, and opinion_view.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DingDuff?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DingDuff in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
DingDuff requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DingDuff is developed by DingDuff. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
